title: Multiply Robust Conformal Risk Control with Coarsened Data
abstract: arXiv:2508.15489v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Conformal Prediction (CP) provides prediction sets with formal coverage guarantees, but most existing methods assume fully observed training and calibration data. In many applications, however, outcomes, covariates, or both may be missing or coarsened. We develop a general framework for predictive inference with coarsened data by combining semiparametric theory with conformal methods.   We introduce two complementary procedures. $(i)$ Robust Split Prediction (RSP) generalizes the doubly robust estimating-equation approach of Yang et al. [2024] beyond the classical missing outcome problem by constructing an efficient influence function based estimating equation and solving its empirical analogue. This yields multiply robust prediction sets under general coarsening patterns. $(ii)$ Robust Split Conformal Prediction (RSCP) instead combines semiparametric theory with conformal risk control. translated_title: 粗化数据下的多重稳健保形风险控制
translated_abstract: 保形预测（CP）为预测集提供了正式的覆盖率保证，但大多数现有方法假设训练数据和校准数据是完全观测的。然而在许多实际应用中，结果变量、协变量或两者都可能出现缺失或粗化。我们通过将半参数理论与保形方法相结合，开发了一个针对粗化数据预测推断的通用框架。我们引入了两种互补的程序：(i) 稳健分裂预测（RSP）通过构造基于有效影响函数的估计方程并求解其经验类似物，将Yang等人[2024]的双重稳健估计方程方法从经典的缺失结果问题推广到更一般的情形，从而在一般粗化模式下产生多重稳健的预测集。(ii) 稳健分裂保形预测（RSCP）则将半参数理论与保形风险控制相结合。由于有效影响函数是……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个结合半参数理论与保形方法的通用框架，通过RSP和RSCP两种互补程序，将双重稳健估计方法推广到一般粗化数据情形，实现了数据缺失或粗化下具有多重稳健性的保形预测与风险控制。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a general framework combining semiparametric theory with conformal methods, introducing two complementary procedures (RSP and RSCP) that generalize doubly robust estimation to general coarsening patterns, thereby achieving multiply robust conformal prediction and risk control when outcomes, covariates, or both are missing or coarsened.
